PLAY-4001 — Duplicate payment retries after a queue redelivery

Severity: major
Resolved: 2026-04-18
Systems affected: payments-worker, orders-api

Timeline

  • 2026-04-17 21:06 UTC — the payments worker is restarted during a routine node drain while 1,900 messages are in flight.
  • 2026-04-17 21:07 UTC — the broker redelivers every unacknowledged message, and the worker charges each one a second time.
  • 2026-04-17 22:40 UTC — the duplicate charges are spotted in the daily settlement report and the worker is stopped.
  • 2026-04-18 — refunds are issued and the incident is closed.

Root cause

The payments worker acknowledged a message only after the charge had settled, but wrote no idempotency key with the charge. A redelivered message was therefore indistinguishable from a new one, and the gateway had no way to reject the second attempt.

Impact

612 customers were charged twice, a duplicated total of CHF 47'300. All of it was refunded within 36 hours; the recorded loss is the CHF 1'240 of non-refundable gateway fees.

Follow-up

  • Derive an idempotency key from the order id and send it with every charge.
  • Alert on a settlement report where any order id appears twice in one day.
